name: saim-app
description: SAiM mobile — SAiM on the go. A lightweight, portable interface to the NEURO brain for capture, focus, chat, meeting prep, and brain management.

scripts.build:alt: node scripts/retired-build.cjs alt-v1 && vite build --config vite.config.alt.js --mode alt
scripts.dev:alt: node scripts/retired-build.cjs alt-v1 && vite --config vite.config.alt.js --mode alt
scripts.build:alt2: node scripts/retired-build.cjs alt-v2 && vite build --config vite.config.alt2.js --mode alt2
scripts.dev:alt2: node scripts/retired-build.cjs alt-v2 && vite --config vite.config.alt2.js --mode alt2
scripts.build:alt3: node scripts/retired-build.cjs alt-v3 && vite build --config vite.config.alt3.js --mode alt3
scripts.dev:alt2-manifest: node scripts/retired-build.cjs alt-v2-manifest && vite --config vite.config.alt2-manifest.js --mode alt2-manifest
scripts.build:legacy: node scripts/retired-build.cjs legacy-control && vite build --mode legacy --outDir dist-legacy && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist-legacy/_redirects','/*  /index.html  200\n')"
